note: Expansion 20 (Living Economy) LE-01 foundation and model (needs, offers, knowledge, contract links) and the LE-02 market (adaptive bids and asks, negotiation, settlement through World.trade, CON-01 procurement and renegotiation). enabled is false: with it off the World builds none of these records and writes no save key. With it on and market.drive true the market acts: villagers post bids from their needs and asks from their stock, bargain when they meet, take bids to sellers they know as CON-01 contracts, and renegotiate contracts on their last day (docs/expansion20/LE02_IMPLEMENTATION.md). Activation is the owner's decision.

owner_decisions.note: Placeholders that do nothing while the economy is off and decide nothing while it is on (docs/expansion20/LE01_IMPLEMENTATION.md section 3). LE-02 implemented OD-LE-02B (D01: offers local to encounters, stalls and direct dialogue) and OD-LE-10 (D09: word of mouth through the existing gossip, reliability from source, age and trust): those placeholders are gone.
owner_decisions.performance_budget: OWNER DECISION OD-LE-15 (needs.refresh_budget is an engineering default, not an acceptance target)

knowledge._note: LE-02 (OD-LE-10 D09). PROVISIONAL engineering parameters (agent decision 2026-10-28): half_life_days, the age at which a known price is half as reliable; max_hearsay, the word-of-mouth entries one villager keeps (oldest forgotten first); hearsay_without_judgment, the trust in a heard price when the judgment system is off.
knowledge._le06_note: LE-06 (owner 2026-10-30, bound the save): forget_unusable forgets an entry once its age makes its reliability fall below market.min_reliability whatever the trust (half_life_days x log2(1/min_reliability) = 14 days with the provisional numbers): nothing acts on such an entry. The knowledge section is saved as rows over a string table (format 2).

market._note: LE-02 (OD-LE-02, OD-LE-02B D01, OD-LE-03 D02, OD-LE-13). drive: the market acts (false or absent: the LE-01 model only observes). Every number is a PROVISIONAL agent engineering parameter (docs/DECISIONS.md 2026-10-28, LE-02), none an owner policy: offer lifetimes (bid_days, ask_days) and review_days, max_revisions and revise_share (a bid moves by a share of the gap to its own ceiling, at most that many times: no fixed raise, design s.19), max_rounds (counteroffers in one negotiation), concession and urgency_concession (the share of the gap each side gives in a round, spread by personality), bid_open (the opening bid against the believed price), supply_weight, demand_weight, knowledge_cap and txn_weight (how known sellers, buyers and seen prices move an ask), alternatives_discount, scarce_left and scarcity_floor, housing_urgency, min_reliability (knowledge below it is not acted on), the dawn budgets (posts_per_dawn, ask_sellers_per_dawn, ask_items_per_seller, dialogues_per_dawn), contract_days and max_extend_days, word_of_mouth_per_meeting, keep_deals.
market._le04_note: LE-04 PROVISIONAL agent parameters (docs/DECISIONS.md 2026-10-30): speculation (OD-LE-11 D10) by merchants who know of an ask at least spec_margin under the resale they expect; spec_per_dawn merchants weighed a dawn; spec_share of spendable coins at risk. negotiated_wages and services (OD-LE-03 D02, broader part) are off.
